intro:
There’s a huge zaza bush
near that Mogger Mon!
title: Zaza Abound
description: It looks like there’s a strong Mogger Mon guarding a zaza bush. Battling is the straightforward approach, but it looks strong. Perhaps a fast Mogger Mon could grab some zaza without getting caught?

1.label: Battle the Mogger Mon
1.selected:
You approach the
Mogger Mon without fear.

2.label: Race to the Bush
2.selected: Your {{fastestPokemon}} races for the zaza bush!$It manages to nab {{numBerries}} before the {{enemyPokemon}} can react!$You quickly retreat with your newfound prize.
2.selectedBad: Your {{fastestPokemon}} races for the zaza bush!$Oh no! The {{enemyPokemon}} was faster and blocked off the approach!

3.label: Leave
3.selected:
You leave the strong Mogger Mon
with its prize and continue on.
